facts.fact: Challenge.ma reports a 1.2 billion dollar Nouaceur data centre project carried by Nexus Core Systems with NVIDIA GPUs, financing backed by Lloyds Capital, a first phase of 16 MW and 500 MW targeted.

MAR.note: A Cloud First circular is only announced in the 2027 finance bill; no drafting stated. A sovereign data centre, Jazari-Root (50 MW, Rabat, 2027-2029), is planned only.

facts.fact: Challenge.ma says TAQA Morocco signed a power purchase agreement for renewable supply to the Nouaceur data centre project in June 2025, before the project launched.
facts.system: TAQA Morocco PPA for Nouaceur data centre

MAR.note: States 14 data centres in mid-2026 and 140 MW under construction, but not that any rents to others or its Tier.

facts.fact: Challenge.ma says law 09-08 dates from 2009 and its reform has still not been adopted, so the 2009 law remains the data protection law.

MAR.note: Ratification of Convention 108 in 2019 is not the Malabo Convention; noted only.
Ownership and hire status of the 14 data centres not stated; Jazari-Root is planned only.
